title: Automate KMS/HSM & TLS rotation for Private Installer (Helm + Terraform)
author: Lin Zhao
body: Context and motivation: Customers running Redwood Private require automated key and certificate rotation for long-lived on-prem deployments. Manual rotation is error-prone and causes downtime during upgrades. This PR adds end-to-end automation for TLS certificate rotation and KMS/HSM key rotation across the Private Installer deployment surface: Helm charts, Terraform modules, and the private-installer upgrade hooks. It supports both Vault (transit engine) and cloud KMS providers, plus PKCS#11-backed HSMs via the existing KMS provider interface. Summary of changes: 1) Terraform: new module 'kms_rotation' with resources and IAM bindings to schedule key rotation, optional HSM binding instructions, and migration tooling to re-encrypt existing sealed secrets during KMS change. 2) Helm: values and templates to orchestrate in-cluster rotation Jobs, pre-upgrade hooks, post-upgrade verification hooks, and rollout strategies to allow zero-downtime TLS swaps (rolling restart with dual-cert acceptance window). 3) Private installer: upgrade/rollback tooling enhancements to detect pending rotations, run canary rotations against a subset of nodes, and rollback hooks that revert to previous cert/key bundle if healthchecks fail. 4) Secrets management: integration utilities for SealedSecrets and Vault. A new 'rotation-controller' Kubernetes job supports two flows: re-seal using a new KMS key or re-wrap Vault transit keys. The controller logs audit entries and emits Prometheus metrics for rotation status. 5) HSM support: PKCS#11 configuration and test harness added to Terraform + installer docs. 6) Tests and docs: unit tests for controller logic, Helm integration tests, Terraform acceptance tests, upgrade-runbook and migration guide. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is no-op unless user enables rotation via values.tf and terraform variables. Migration path: documented step-by-step with a helper script 'rekey-migrate' included in the installer image. Operational details: rotations are performed using a staged approach: generate new keypair/cert, publish both old+new to LB/ingress for the acceptance window, run rolling restarts, switch primary key reference, and then retire old key after a safety delay. The rollout ensures compatibility with older clients during transition. Security notes: KMS credentials are never written to plain manifests. Vault tokens are fetched via controller service account with minimal RBAC. All rotation events are auditable and recorded to the platform audit-log sink. CI/CD: added terraform-validate and terraform-plan checks and an e2e workflow that spins up a VPC test cluster (small) and runs a smoke rotation to validate zero-downtime behavior. Why this change matters: reduces operator toil, enables compliance (automated rotation windows), and improves reliability during KMS/HSM migrations. Related work: ENG-3245 initial design doc, ENG-3301 rollout policy work, SUP-1123 customer request for automated rotation. Merge notes: squash merge with release note included below.
commits: feat(kms): add terraform module kms_rotation with IAM bindings and example usage
feat(installer): add rekey-migrate helper script and image build step
feat(helm): add rotation-controller chart, pre/post upgrade hooks, dual-cert templates
feat(controller): implement rotation-controller with Vault and KMS adapters
chore(tests): add helm integration tests and terraform acceptance tests for rotation flow
docs: add upgrade-runbook and rekey migration guide
fix(hsm): PKCS11 env detection and config fallback
review_comments: Aisha Patel: Could we add metric labels for cluster_id and deployment_id on rotation_controller_rotations_total? I want to be able to filter by customer during debugging.
Lin Zhao: Added cluster_id and deployment_id labels to the emitted Prometheus metrics in the latest commit.
Diego Martinez: Suggest making the dual-cert acceptance window configurable via helm values with a sane default (7 minutes). Also double-check s2i image size for the controller.
Lin Zhao: Exposed acceptanceWindowSeconds in values.yaml and verified controller image is <120MB after multi-stage build.
Samir Gupta: Can the terraform module optionally create an IAM scheduler resource? Some customers want managed rotation schedules.
Lin Zhao: Added optional 'create_rotation_schedule' boolean and example schedule resource in the module. Kept disabled by default.
Diego Martinez: CI e2e failed once due to GCP quotas, retriggered and green. Approving post-green.
Aisha Patel: Verified upgrade-runbook steps end-to-end in a VPC lab. Approving.
Samir Gupta: Approved and requested release notes entry.
release_notes: Added automated KMS/HSM and TLS rotation support for Private Installer. New Terraform module 'kms_rotation', Helm charts and rotation-controller to perform staged key/cert swaps with zero-downtime acceptance window. Migration helper 'rekey-migrate' included. HSM (PKCS#11) support and Vault transit integration included. Backwards compatible and disabled by default. See docs/private/rotation-runbook.md for migration steps.
notes: Post-merge actions: cut a patch release for private-installer images, notify platform-ops runbook, and schedule a webinar for early customers. Ensure marketplace listings include new HSM notes.
